Eastman Solus™ 5350 performance additive is designed to provide high-performance in building and construction coatings. This cellulose ester enables coatings to exhibit UV stability & non-yellowing, excellent inter-coat adhesion, clear films, and superior avoidance of surface defects via flow & leveling properties. Production benefits include reduced surface tack, improved thermal reflow, broad compatibility with curing resins & other coating components, low solution viscosity and solubility in a wide range of solvents & solvent combinations. When dissolved in appropriate solvents, a clear colorless solution is produced. Solus™ 5350 is supplied in pellet form, offering formulation convenience, ease of handling and maximum formulating flexibility. </br></br></br> Eastman Solus™ 5350 is based on cellulose, one of the most abundant natural renewable resources.</br></br></br> For applications that require food contact compliance, please discuss requirements with your Eastman technical expert.

Modern packaging formulations are expected to deliver stunning colors, high print throughput, flawless finishes, and durable graphics, all while protecting the safety of end-users. Eastman Solus™ 1225 performance additive is designed to deliver on the high performance expectations required of ink and metal packaging formulations. This cellulose-based additive enables formulations with good resistance to UV discoloration, excellent hardness and anti-blocking properties in support of high production speeds. Solus™ 1225 is well adapted for use in printing inks and overprint varnishes as a result of its wide solubility in relevant solvents, strong compatibility with other ink resins, desirable resistance to grease and oil, low odor properties, and high melting point. When Solus™ 1225 is dissolved in appropriate solvents a clear, colorless solution is produced. Supplied as a dry free-flowing powder, this product is often used in combination with other Solus™ products to optimize the formulation viscosity. </br></br> </br></br> Eastman Solus™ 1225 is based on cellulose, one of Earth's most abundant natural renewable resources, with an approximate calculated bio-content value of 45%. </br></br> </br></br> For applications that require food contact compliance, please refer to Eastman Solus™ 1225, food contact and discuss requirements with your Eastman technical representative.

Puma Biotechnology, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company with a focus on the development and commercialization of innovative products to enhance cancer care. Puma in-licensed the global development and commercialization rights to PB272 (neratinib, oral), PB272 (neratinib, intravenous), and PB357. Puma in-licensed global research and development and commercial rights to alisertib, a selective, small molecule, orally administered inhibitor of aurora kinase A. Neratinib is a potent irreversible tyrosine kinase inhibitor that blocks signal transduction through the epidermal growth factor receptors, HER1, HER2 and HER4. Puma has been focused on developing the oral version of neratinib, and its most advanced drug candidates are directed at the treatment of HER2-positive breast cancer. Puma believes that neratinib has clinical applications in the treatment of several other cancers as well, including non-small cell lung cancer and other solid tumor types that over-express or have a mutation in HER2. Neratinib, oral was approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for the extended adjuvant treatment of adult patients with early stage HER2-overexpressed/amplified breast cancer, following adjuvant trastuzumab-based therapy. Puma commenced commercial sales of the drug and it is marketed in the United States as NERLYNX® tablets. In, NERLYNX was also approved by the FDA in combination with capecitabine for the treatment of adult patients with advanced or metastatic HER2-positive breast cancer who have received two or more prior anti-HER2-based regimens in the metastatic setting. NERLYNX was granted marketing authorization by the European Commission for the extended adjuvant treatment of adult patients with early stage hormone receptor-positive HER2-overexpressed/amplified breast cancer and who are less than one year from completion of prior adjuvant trastuzumab-based therapy. Commercial sales commenced in the European Union. Puma has entered into additional exclusive license agreements with various parties to commercialize NERLYNX in regions outside the United States, including the European Union, Canada, Latin America, Greater China, Israel, Southeast Asia, Australia, New Zealand, South Korea, the Middle East, and parts of Africa. Puma plans to continue to pursue the commercialization of NERLYNX outside the United States. Alisertib is an adenosine triphosphateâcompetitive and reversible inhibitor of aurora kinase A and results in disruption of mitosis leading to apoptosis of rapidly proliferating tumor cells that are dependent on aurora kinase A. Alisertib has been tested in Clinical Trials in patients with metastatic cancers including breast cancer, small cell lung cancer, head and neck cancer, ovarian cancer, peripheral T cell lymphoma and acute myeloid leukemia. Puma initially intends to focus the development of alisertib on the treatment of patients with metastatic estrogen receptor-positive (ER-positive) HER2-negative breast cancer, triple-negative breast cancer and small cell lung cancer. Renewable diesel is a type of advanced biofuel that is derived from sustainable feedstocks such as vegetable oils, natural fats and greases. Unlike traditional diesel, renewable diesel emits fewer greenhouse gases making it a more environmentally friendly alternative to fossil fuels. Oil-Dri Corporation of America is making significant contributions towards building a sustainable future by providing the renewable diesel market with highly efficient adsorbent solutions to effectively remove contaminants and protect downstream equipment and catalysts. These adsorbents have ideal properties for the pretreatment of various feedstocks and feedstock blends by removing trace metals and elements, including a full spectrum of organic and inorganic phosphorus. With the growing demand of renewable diesel as an alternative fuel source, Oil-Dri will continue to support this clean energy initiative.

Chronic respiratory conditions and neuromuscular disorders can make it harder for the lungs to clear mucus. Changes in the airways—such as swelling or inflammation—can cause mucus to stick, and for people with neuromuscular disorders, weak cough muscles may prevent mucus from being cleared at all. When mucus can’t move, it can build up over time, leading to chronic cough, infection, and flare‑ups. AffloVest is a comfortable, effective, and connected airway clearance therapy that helps gently loosen and move mucus so it can be cleared more easily—helping people breathe easier and stay engaged in daily life, at home or on the go.
